title: Asymmetric natural adapter views

draw.eligible_rule: registry priority=P0 and status=UNTESTED, excluding IDs with a live origin/research/ma-* branch or pre-existing experiments/mirror_applications/ma-* directory

hypothesis: Across independently fine-tuned rank-1 BERT adapters, a shared output-side (LoRA B) subspace retains held-out task updates better than a byte-matched shared input-side (LoRA A) subspace and uses <=80% of independent LoRA payload bytes at <=10% relative update error.
physical_object: Per-layer BERT query/value LoRA rank-1 weight updates from three public tweet_eval adapters
mirror_coordinate: Per-task coefficients in a train-task-only shared factor subspace
logical_multiplicity: Three task-specific learned updates represented through shared output or input bases

data.base_training_revision: unreported by adapter cards; cannot be independently verified
data.adapter_base_claim: all three cards name bert-base-uncased; model card does not pin base commit
data.source_artifacts: SHA-256 values, file lengths and exact task mapping recorded in source/artifact_manifest.json

controls: Shared output-side basis with per-task code and private input factor
Shared input-side basis with per-task code and private output factor
Two-sided shared U/V bases with dense per-task core (native shared-core control)

development.selection_metric: No development tuning; k in {1,2} and all three whole-task leave-one-out folds are fixed before numerical analysis.

storage.format: safetensors; exact file size on disk

compute.report_tokens_or_examples: No task examples used; three checkpoints, 24 matched matrices each
compute.compute_proxy: SVD/projection MAC estimates plus decoder matrix multiply MACs

success_gate: B-side median held-out error is at least 10% lower than A-side; every fold error <=0.10; serialized payload <=80% of independent LoRA; and no dense-core domination at matched error.
failure_gate: Any success gate fails or a gauge perturbation changes the verdict beyond 1e-8 projector/error tolerance.
boundaries: Oracle update reconstruction is not downstream task quality.
No new code was learned from examples.
Base adapter cards do not provide training-time base commit SHA.
Three related tweet_eval tasks do not establish generality or Mirror-specific novelty.
